# Regression test for #35: sub-component widget fields must be declared on
# the Model struct. Previously the generated model.go used m.label1..m.label4
# inside renderDetailPanel but those fields were not declared → compile error.

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# renderDetailPanel render method must be emitted
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) renderDetailPanel\(it Issue\) fyne\.CanvasObject' out/model.go

# Post-Plan-C widget fields are named __nN by the lowering pass
# (rather than the legacy label1..label4 per-tag counters). The four
# detail-panel text() nodes get distinct fields so the Model struct
# declares each one.
grep '__n4 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep '__n5 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep '__n6 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep '__n7 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { fyne } }

struct Issue {
    key string
    summary string
    status string
    assignee string
}

component main {
    var current = Issue{}

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            text(value="header")
            detailPanel(it=current)
        }
    }
}

component detailPanel(it Issue) {
    vbox {
        text(value=it.key)
        text(value=it.summary)
        text(value=it.status)
        text(value=it.assignee)
    }
}
